title: Armored Warrior Stance
description: A male warrior with spiky brown hair stands in a dynamic combat pose, wearing ornate metallic armor with red and gold accents, a tattered grey kilt, and gauntlets. He holds a large ornate sword in his right hand while raising his left fist, set against a dark background with layered text elements reading 'STAINED', 'METASTASIS', and 'UNLOCKED'.
